name: nhs-ae-four-hour-decline
description: For an NHS England provider operating a consultant-led (Type 1) A&E department with at least 100 Type 1 attendances in each of months M and M+1, will the provider's Type 1 within-4-hour performance rate decline in month M+1 relative to month M, given the provider's monthly A&E series (attendances by department type, over-4-hour counts, decision-to-admit waits, emergency admissions) for all months through M, plus the calendar?
license: Open Government Licence v3.0 (NHS England / Crown copyright). Derived research dataset - not NHS England's official product.

split.strategy: temporal on the target month M+1

label_rule: declines = 1 iff within4h_rate(M+1) < within4h_rate(M), within4h_rate(Y) = 1 - Attendances over 4hrs Type 1 / A&E attendances Type 1; provider-months with Type 1 attendances < 100 in either month are excluded
prediction_time: At the publication of month M's monthly A&E CSV, about ten days after month M ends (observed: the August 2026 file was published 2026-09-10). Every feature is derived from the provider's monthly series for months <= M and every eligibility test uses those same months; the label is month M+1's within-4-hour rate versus month M's, published about a month later. The instant is the publication date, not the period end: at the end of month M these values did not yet exist.
